notes: The ASV writes both 'forth' and 'out of', so the preverb's particle stays with the verb and the expressed ἐκ keeps its own full gloss (rule 106, on the pattern of 'coming up out of the water').
τό before the vocative πνεῦμα takes the supplied address word 'thou' under rule 89; the second attributive article is unrepresented.
